remarks: Feel yourself ease into total relaxation as you step into a world of dramatic desert romance at 1907 Mesa Drive, located in the highly coveted Mesa Neighborhood of Palm Springs - just moments away from the best shopping on S Palm Canyon Drive, and top restaurants like Bar Cecil, El Mirasol, and Mr. Lyon's just a stone's throw outside your door. Perfectly positioned against the backdrop of Palm Springs' iconic mountains, this exquisite Spanish estate effortlessly blends old-world Mediterranean charm with an irresistible elegance. From the moment you step through the entrance, the home invites you to slow down and indulge. Stay in and enjoy cooking at home in the completely remodeled kitchen
